eligibility.quote:
When you call `rcl_wait()`, the timeout passed to `rmw_wait()` is calculated [like](https://github.com/ros2/rcl/blob/c83119c826c75fbaf6e741658927a953318832ad/rcl/src/rcl/wait.c#L546-L582):

`min(rcl_wait_timeout, minimal_timeout_to_next_timer_trigger)`

but the timer might be using a different clock that the one `rmw_wait()` uses ....

As a consequence:
- if `rmw_wait` uses the system clock, a rcl timer using steady time isn't going to work fine (issue happens when system time is adjusted backwards)...
